lastCompletedStory.title: Fix auto-chain defeating the MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT non-convergence terminal

nextStoryContext: US-008 fixes the DUAL INTERACTION bug where the US-005 auto-chain defeated the US-006 non-convergence hard terminal. Three-layer fix: (1) review.ts: `newRound > maxRounds` changed to `newRound >= maxRounds` so the terminal round (newRound==maxRounds) with FIXES_PENDING skips buildFixStories and sets MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT directly, preventing orphan fix stories; (2) sidecar.ts makeHasPendingStories: added MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT guard before Case (a) so the auto-chain never sees false-pending at the non-convergence terminal; (3) decide.ts decideNextAction: moved review state resolution before Case 1 and added `!verdictIsMaxDebt` guard to Case 1 so orphan stories cannot route back to implement. Existing US-006 non-convergence-terminal tests all still pass. 12 new behavioral oracle tests in test/supervisor/non-convergence-autochain.test.ts cover all 4 ACs.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure TypeScript fix in src/supervisor/review.ts, src/supervisor/decide.ts, src/commands/sidecar.ts. No external library code was touched.
